notes: San Bernardino CPCs are almost entirely free text, similar to San Diego and Santa Barbara formats. Certificate header and producer info are interleaved in a two-column free-text layout on page 1. Production sites are in a paired two-column table (Site # / Site Address | Site # / Site Address). Storage locations appear as a single line section. Authorized counties are listed in a multi-column row. Producers sell-for and selling-for-me are in a side-by-side layout with ISSUING COUNTY/CERTIFICATE NO/DATE DECLARED sub-headers. Commodities are numbered rows with colon-separated line numbers (e.g. '1: 1 BROCCOLI...'). The first pdfplumber table is the signature/certification boilerplate. The second table is PRODUCTION SITE(s). Commodity data is parsed from page text as positional columns. A '*** LAST ENTRY' marker signals end of commodity data. Sell-for lists are side by side: producers_i_sell_for is read from x < 300, producers_selling_for_me from x >= 300, each starting after its DATE DECLARED: heading (verified only on a CPC with both lists empty). Production sites parse as numbered text with the APN split off.
